summary: Greater pre-rejection directional extension has a small positive pooled association with 4H countertrend return, but the extreme-extension cohort remains negative after spread, the relationship is unstable across development/validation eras, only 6/10 pairs improve, cooldown removes statistical support, and extension-matched S2/R2 does not add reversal expectancy. The frozen promotion gate fails and 2026 remains unopened.

primary_findings.uncertainty: 95% pair-year bootstrap CI [-0.201239,+0.027901]; 1,279 valid E3 observations

robustness: A 4H same-pair/same-reversal-direction cooldown reduces the sample to 141,000 and leaves E3 mean negative (-0.1018 H1 ATR); the continuous slope CI then crosses zero.
Extreme-extension path amplitude increases in both directions: E3 reversal MFE 1.058 H1 ATR and adverse continuation MAE 1.316 H1 ATR.
At E3, +0.5 ATR reversal is reached first in 45.89% while -0.5 ATR continuation is reached first in 54.03% of path-observable events.
A 20-observation direct-source 2024 audit reproduces extension, executable entry price and REV4 with maximum absolute error 0.0.
Secondary 8H E3 mean turns slightly positive (+0.0134 H1 ATR), but 4H was preregistered primary and horizon switching is prohibited.
limitations: 2015-2025 was exposed in related pivot research; only this generic extension architecture was newly preregistered.
E3 is rare, so uncertainty is materially wider than in low-extension cohorts.
The positive pooled continuous slope is not stable across historical partitions and is concentrated in 2022-2025.
No commission beyond observed BID/ASK spread and no ordinary slippage were added.
2026 YTD remains unopened and is not confirmation evidence for this study.
authorized_next: Retain directional extension as a potentially regime-sensitive descriptive state variable, not as a standalone mean-reversion rule.
If further research is undertaken, require a materially different market hypothesis rather than another extension threshold, pivot subset or horizon rescue.
prohibited_next: Do not retune the 0.75/1.25/1.75 extension thresholds or replace Daily ATR20 normalization based on these outcomes.
Do not select only 2022-2025, only favorable pairs, only upper/lower rejections, only S2 or only R2.
Do not switch the primary horizon to 8H because its descriptive E3 mean is positive.
Do not optimize stops, targets, sessions, weekdays or indicator filters on this failed architecture.
Do not open 2026 YTD to rescue the failed internal gate.
